compatibility_requirements.title: VBA On Error runtime semantics
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Implement a compatibility runtime for Resume Next, GoTo handler, GoTo 0, Err state and handler activation; this pass preserves directives but does not emulate execution.

compatibility_requirements.title: Late-bound COM/Object members
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Define explicit Java interfaces/adapters for the actual COM object behavior. Object-typed references alone do not identify the target API.

compatibility_requirements.title: COM object activation
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Replace ProgID-based activation with an explicit Java implementation or integration adapter; preserve fallback behavior.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Currency fixed-point arithmetic
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Use fixed-point decimal arithmetic with four decimal places and verify rounding/overflow rules.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Date representation
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Map VBA/OLE Automation dates carefully; verify serial-date conversions, timezone assumptions and date parsing/formatting.

compatibility_requirements.title: Variant dynamic values
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve runtime type changes, Empty/Null distinctions, arrays stored in Variant, and VBA conversion rules.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Is object-reference comparison
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve object identity/null comparison semantics; distinguish Is from value equality.

limitations.message: On Error runtime behavior needs a target implementation.
CreateObject requires a Java adapter for the requested COM server.
Assignment target cannot be lowered safely.
VBA host object 'ThisWorkbook' requires an application-specific Java adapter.

note: Compilation verifies Java syntax only, not behavioral equivalence or availability of VBA host adapters.
